articles.title: Symbiotic aims to make tokenized assets easier to cash out with new liquidity network
articles.snippet: Liquid Lane aims to solve a key bottleneck that is holding back growth of tokenized funds and credit: long redemption times, Symbiotic cofounder Misha Putiatin said.

articles.title: Georgia targets illegal crypto mining in Mestia crackdown: Report
articles.snippet: Georgia will reportedly install electricity meters across Mestia to curb illegal crypto mining after officials blamed miners for grid strain and outages.

articles.title: Crossmint enables Visa card payments for AI agents and autonomous commerce
articles.snippet: The new API lets AI agents make purchases with eligible Visa cards using tokenized credentials and spending controls, expanding payment options for autonomous software.

articles.title: Debate on CLARITY Act continues this week as US Senate returns
articles.snippet: Many Democratic lawmakers have said that they will not support any version of a crypto market structure bill without provisions on ethics to address potential conflicts of interest by elected officials.
